Three steps to the altar

  1. Pick what you wantAdd ranks, claim blocks or Hat Tokens to your basket. You can buy for a friend too.
  2. Enter your Minecraft nameExactly as it is in game. That's who gets it.
  3. Pay securely through TebexCard or PayPal. Ranks apply within a minute. Hats arrive the next time you're online, straight into your inventory.

Fair play promise. Nothing on this store helps you in PvP. Patron flight only works inside your own claim, Chosen can fly anywhere, and either switches off the moment you're in a fight. Homes and ender chest are blocked after combat and while captured.

    Before you play

    Server rules 16+

    BaffoonMC is a cosy survival server with a wicked streak. Build, farm and make friends, but keep an eye on your chests: a little crime is part of the fun. People always get respect.

    BaffoonMC is for players aged 16 and over: expect swearing, crime, kidnapping and the odd cheeky build.

    Allowed

    • FarmsMob farms, crop farms and AFK farms, as long as they don't lag the server.
    • Exploring and claimingGo anywhere and claim any unclaimed land to call home. Only God's island can't be claimed.
    • PvPFight anyone in the wild. PvP is turned off inside land claims, and at spawn, Moloch's temple and God's island. Die to a player and everything you're carrying drops; die to anything else and you keep it all.
    • StealingTake from any chest you can get into, loot what people drop, pick a lock with a Thief Key.
    • KidnappingHood, cudgel and shackles are part of the game. So is escaping. How it works
    • DeceptionLies, betrayals, fake alliances and sneaky trades. Trust carefully.
    • ScamsFake trades, broken promises, junk sold as treasure. If a deal seems too good, it probably is.
    • SwearingSwearing's fine, just don't overdo it. Use a bit of common sense and keep chat readable for everyone.

    Not allowed

    • GriefingDon't destroy, burn, flood or deface anyone's builds. Take what's inside, leave the build standing.
    • Personal attacksNo insults about someone's race, religion, gender, sexuality, disability, looks, family or real life. Roast the play, not the person.
    • Real-life harmNo threats, no sharing anyone's personal details, nothing that follows someone outside the game.
    • CheatingNo hacked clients, X-ray, duping or abusing bugs. Found one? Report it.
    • Being unreasonableNo spawn-camping, and don't hound the same player over and over. Win, then move on.
    • Building on someone's doorstepBuild at least 350 blocks from another player's base, unless the owner says it's fine.
    • AdvertisingNo promoting other servers or Discords.
    • SpammingDon't flood chat: no repeating the same message, walls of caps or copy-pasted junk. That goes for the Discord too.
    • Misusing alt accountsAlts are for AFKing only, and must follow your main account's Soul position.

    Builds, art and skins

    • Cheeky is fine, with a warningRaunchy jokes, suggestive statues, raunchy map art and pixel art, and innuendo are part of the fun, but warn people first: put a sign outside, like "Cheeky build ahead", so they can choose not to look.
    • Explicit isn'tNo pornographic builds, map art, pixel art, banners, signs, books or skins. It gets removed.
    • Not sure? Ask firstPlanning art, a statue or anything borderline? Run it past a staff member before you build.

    Steal the loot, not the build. Roast the play, not the person.

    Staff have the final say. Breaking a rule can mean a warning, a temporary ban or a permanent one. Want to help keep it that way? Apply for staff.

    Free · earned, never bought

    Level up

    Everyone starts as a Newcomer. Vote for BaffoonMC with /vote and you climb eleven ranks, each with its own coloured chat tag, more homes as you go, and now and then a handy command. Every rank keeps everything from the ones below it.

    1. #RankTo reach itHomesWhat it adds
    2. 1[Newcomer]Start here1 home/home, /sethome, /spawn, /tpa, /rtp, /msg
    3. 2[Beginner]5 votesabout 1 day1 home/back: return to where you died
    4. 3[Novice]35 votesabout a week2 homes/workbench: a crafting table anywhere
    5. 4[Intermediate]100 votesabout 3 weeks2 homes/disposal: a bin for junk
    6. 5[Advanced]175 votesabout 5 weeks3 homesAnother home and a new tag
    7. 6[Adept]275 votesabout 8 weeks3 homesA new tag
    8. 7[Expert]400 votesabout 3 months4 homesAnother home and a new tag
    9. 8[Seasoned]550 votesabout 4 months4 homes/hat: wear any block on your head
    10. 9[Veteran]750 votesabout 5 months5 homesAnother home and a new tag
    11. 10[Elder]1,150 votesabout 8 months6 homes/enderchest: your ender chest anywhere
    12. 11[Ancient]2,000 votesabout 13 months6 homesClaim flight: fly inside your own claims (switches off in fights), and the rarest tag on the server

    How voting works

    Type /vote in game for the links. There are five sites and each gives one vote a day, so that's up to five votes a day. The days shown assume you use all five. You rank up by yourself the moment you hit the number.

    Bought a rank too?

    Supporter, Patron and Chosen sit alongside your level, not instead of it. Your level tag stays, and your bronze, silver or gold stars appear next to it.

    Staff tags

    [Helper] [Mod] [Admin] [Owner]
    These are the people to ask when something's wrong. They can't be bought or voted for.
